annotations.title: Start a strategy inside the mandate

description: Start a listed idea or trader with allocation_usd of the mandate's budget. It then trades by its own rules and stops; every opening order is checked against the mandate's limits before it is signed. Charged like any Fexr strategy (60 compute units a day).

allocation_usd.description: Money this strategy may use, inside the mandate's budget.
allocation_usd.title: Allocation Usd

leverage.description: Optional. Never above the strategy's own or the mandate's leverage.
leverage.title: Leverage

mandate_id.description: Only needed when there is more than one mandate.
mandate_id.title: Mandate Id

name: start_strategy
